dialogue.content: おはようございます。時間になったら始めさせていただきますのでよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good morning. We will begin at the scheduled time. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: おはようございます本日宜しくお願い致します
dialogue.English: Good morning. Thank you for your time today.

dialogue.content: 「リクエスト希望ありましたら気軽に相談してくださいね」
dialogue.English: "If you have any requests, please feel free to let me know."

dialogue.content: よろしければお言葉に甘えて、中2女子のあまり返事がないラインコのが続いているので相談対象を20歳以上の方にお願いできれば幸いです！！
dialogue.English: If it's okay, I'd like to take you up on that. I've been doing a role-play with a middle school girl who doesn't reply much, so I'd appreciate it if the client could be someone 20 years or older!

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 「相談内容は何がいいとかありますか？」
dialogue.English: "Is there a specific topic you'd like to discuss?"

dialogue.content: 「普段は結構話していますので大丈夫だと思います」
dialogue.English: "I'm usually quite talkative, so I think it will be fine."

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございます。内容は大丈夫です。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you. The topic is fine.)

dialogue.content: 「ありがとうございますでは宜しくお願い致します」
dialogue.English: "Thank you. Well then, let's begin."

dialogue.content: （よろしくお願いいたします！）
dialogue.English: (Let's begin!)

dialogue.content: 「こちらこそ宜しくお願い致します」
dialogue.English: "Likewise, thank you."

dialogue.content: おはようございます。相談員です。まず初めに性別と年齢をお聞かせください。
dialogue.English: Good morning. I am the counselor. First, could you please tell me your gender and age?

dialogue.content: おはようございます今日は宜しくお願いします３２歳女です
dialogue.English: Good morning. Thank you for your time today. I'm a 32-year-old woman.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日のご相談内容は、どのようなものでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 旦那の事で相談に来ました
dialogue.English: I came to talk about my husband.

dialogue.content: わかりました。ありがとうございます。もう少し、詳しいことを教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Thank you. Could you tell me a little more about it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 最近ちょっと帰りが遅かったり浮気かもしれないなと思って不安なんです
dialogue.English: Recently, he's been coming home a bit late, and I'm worried he might be having an affair.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか、それは不安になりますね、、、いつぐらいから帰りが遅いんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, that must be worrying... Around when did he start coming home late?

dialogue.content: コロナ前くらいからです
dialogue.English: It started around before COVID.

dialogue.content: かれこれ2年前、ぐらいということですね？
dialogue.English: So, for about two years now, is that right?

dialogue.content: はいそうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 2年ぐらい前に、何か旦那さんが帰りが遅くなるようなきっかけはありましたか？
dialogue.English: Was there anything about two years ago that might have triggered your husband to start coming home late?

dialogue.content: 飲みにいくのが増えてそこからですね
dialogue.English: He started going out for drinks more, and that's when it started.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、飲みに行くことが増えて、だんだん帰りも尾所遅くなって、、その時は、御主人に最近飲んでくる回数が多いね？みたいに聞かれたこととかはありますか？
dialogue.English: I see, he started going out for drinks more, and gradually came home later and later... At that time, did you ever ask him something like, "You've been going out drinking a lot recently, haven't you?"

dialogue.content: （すみません、遅くなってです）
dialogue.English: (Sorry, I meant "coming home late.")

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その時、旦那さんは何とおっしゃいましたか？
dialogue.English: What did your husband say then?

dialogue.content: 聞いたりはしましたが付き合いだからと言われたりしたのでそれ以上いうこともなく
dialogue.English: I did ask, but he said it was for work relations, so I didn’t press further.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうなんですね、その時は、付き合いだから仕方がないと思ったけれども、
dialogue.English: I see. So at that time, you thought it couldn't be helped because it was for work, but...

dialogue.content: 今も付き合いだから飲んで帰るの仕方ないという感情ですか？
dialogue.English: Do you still feel that it can't be helped because he's drinking for work obligations?

dialogue.content: 妥協はありますね
dialogue.English: I've come to accept it, to some extent.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。少し2年目を振り返ってみたいと思うのですが、2年目の家庭環境はいかがでしたか？
dialogue.English: I see. I'd like to look back a bit on the past two years. How was your home environment during that time?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 子供のいない家庭なので週一　二で飲みにいくことはありましたが頻繁にほぼ毎日っていうのはなかったですね
dialogue.English: We don't have children, so he would go out drinking once or twice a week, but it was never as frequent as almost every day.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それが回数が増え、同じ状況に私もいれば同じように不安になると思います。
dialogue.English: I see. So the frequency increased. If I were in the same situation, I think I would feel just as anxious.

dialogue.content: 2年前のご主人のお仕事や他、なにかきっかけみたいなことはお心当たりはないですか？
dialogue.English: Two years ago, was there anything related to your husband's work or anything else that you can think of that might have been a trigger?

dialogue.content: おっ分を晴らして飲みに行くような出来事という意味ですが
dialogue.English: I mean an event that might have made him want to go drinking to blow off steam.

dialogue.content: きっかけは特には
dialogue.English: No particular trigger.

dialogue.content: 心当たりないんです
dialogue.English: I can't think of anything.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、何か最近多く出かけていることに関して、御主人と話し合いはされましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. Have you discussed his recent increase in going out with him?

dialogue.content: 最近は帰りも遅いし時々出張もあるみたいで家を空けることも増えました
dialogue.English: Lately, he comes home late, and it seems he sometimes has business trips, so he's away from home more often.

dialogue.content: 忙しいと言われるので部署も変わって仕事が増えたとかで
dialogue.English: He says he’s busy—that his department changed and his workload increased, or something like that.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、旦那さんはお仕事がんばっていらっしゃるんですね
dialogue.English: I see; it sounds like your husband is working hard.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうだと信じたいです
dialogue.English: I want to believe so.

dialogue.content: ええ、私もそう願います。貴方的には、希望することは今の状況でどんなことなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Yes, I hope so too. For you, what would you hope for in this current situation?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 個人的には少しでも不安がなくなればいいなと思うのですが
dialogue.English: Personally, I wish I could feel even a little less anxious.

dialogue.content: そうですね、少しこの場でその不安な気持ちを少し、吐き出してみませんか？
dialogue.English: Yes. Would you like to try and vent some of those anxious feelings here?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so.

dialogue.content: もしかしたら、すっきりするかもしれませんし、きずかなかったことがあるかもしれません
dialogue.English: You might feel better, and you might discover something you hadn't realized before.

dialogue.content: いつも飲みに行ってるのは家に帰りたくないんじゃないのかなとも思ってしまうので
dialogue.English: I can't help but think that the reason he's always out drinking is that he doesn't want to come home.

dialogue.content: ちょっと辛いです
dialogue.English: It’s a bit painful.

dialogue.content: ええ、家に帰りたくないから飲みに行っていると思われてるんですね？
dialogue.English: Yes, so you feel he might be going out drinking because he doesn’t want to come home?

dialogue.content: 以前はそこまで飲みにいくとかなかったので
dialogue.English: He didn't used to go out drinking that much before.

dialogue.content: 書斎に籠るようにもなってあまり家にいることも減ったので
dialogue.English: He also started shutting himself in his study, so he's around the house less.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、そうしますと今のあなたの心配は、浮気よりも家に帰りたくないのかな？家にいたくないのかな？と思われているということでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. So, is it that your current worry is less about an affair and more about whether he doesn't want to come home, or doesn't want to be at home?

dialogue.content: どちらもあって不安です
dialogue.English: I'm anxious about both.

dialogue.content: そうですね、例えば、どなたかご自分のお母さんやご友人にこの件で相談されましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. For example, have you spoken to anyone about this, like your mother or a friend?

dialogue.content: カウンセラーさん私はおかしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Counselor, am I strange for thinking this?

dialogue.content: いいえ、同じ状況なら私も同じように不安だし、頭いっぱいいっぱいになりますよ。
dialogue.English: No, not at all. In the same situation, I would feel just as anxious and overwhelmed.

dialogue.content: まだできてません仲のいい昔からの友達に少し話したくらいです
dialogue.English: I haven't really. I've only talked about it a little with a close friend I've known for a long time.

dialogue.content: そうですよねありがとうございます
dialogue.English: You're right... Thank you.

dialogue.content: そのお友達は、貴方のことを昔から知っているので少しは状況がわかると思うのですが、何かそのお友達は言われてましたか？さしつかえなかったら教えてください。
dialogue.English: Since that friend has known you for a long time, I imagine she might understand the situation a bit. Did she say anything? If you don't mind sharing, could you please tell me?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 詳しく話してないですが最近飲みに行ってばかりでというと女？って普通に言われて泣きそうになりました
dialogue.English: I didn't go into detail, but when I mentioned he's been going out drinking all the time lately, she just said, "Another woman?" and I felt like crying.

dialogue.content: それは、わたしでも泣きそうになります、、、
dialogue.English: That would make me feel like crying too...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: とても辛かったです
dialogue.English: It was very painful.

dialogue.content: それは、本当に、きずつきますよね、もしかしたら、あなたはただ最近、仕事忙しくて旦那が飲みに行ってばかりだな、、と普通に考えていたのに、仲のいい人に、急に女？と言われて気になり始めたのではないのかと感じたのですが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: That must have really hurt. I get the sense that perhaps you were just thinking, "My husband's busy with work and going out drinking a lot lately," but when your close friend suddenly said, "Another woman?" that's when you started to really worry. Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: 友達は離婚も子供もいないしするのも全然いいと思うっていうんです
dialogue.English: My friend doesn't have kids and isn't married, and she says she thinks getting a divorce is perfectly fine.

dialogue.content: はいそうですね相談して余計気になりました悔しいですけど事実なので
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. Talking to her made me worry more. It's frustrating, but it's the reality.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、お友達に離婚も全然かまわないみたいに、いわれたときどのようなお気持ちになりましたか？
dialogue.English: I see. When your friend said something like getting a divorce is fine, how did that make you feel?

dialogue.content: やっぱりちょっとショックででも、友達は私のこと思ってかけてくれた言葉だとおもうんbです
dialogue.English: It was a bit of a shock, but I think my friend said it out of concern for me.

dialogue.content: すみませんちょっとうち間違えました
dialogue.English: Sorry, I made a typo.

dialogue.content: ええ、でも貴方的には離婚を考えていらっしゃるんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I understand. But are you, yourself, considering divorce?

dialogue.content: 男は旦那だけじゃないって言われて
dialogue.English: She told me, "He's not the only man out there."

dialogue.content: 確かにそうですね、、、
dialogue.English: That is true...

dialogue.content: 浮気や不倫は嫌ですが証拠とって慰謝料とればいいんだよって言われて辛いです
dialogue.English: I hate the idea of cheating or affairs, but she said, "You should just get proof and take alimony," and that's painful to hear.

dialogue.content: ほんとはなんでなのか話したいですが避けられたりもされてる気もしますしもう無理なのかなとも
dialogue.English: Honestly, I want to talk about why this is happening, but I feel like he’s avoiding me at times, and I wonder if it’s already hopeless.

dialogue.content: でも貴方的には関係を修復させて位という気持ちはありますか？
dialogue.English: But do you have a desire to repair the relationship?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: できたらそうしたい気持ちはあります
dialogue.English: If possible, I would like to.

dialogue.content: 教えていただきありがとうございます。少し状況をまとめさせてください。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing. Let me summarize the situation a bit.

dialogue.content: 宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: コロナ前約2年前ぐらいから旦那さんの飲みに行く回数が増えた。ここであなたは浮気かな？少しふあんになってしまった。家にいるときも、書斎にこもってしまってあまり顔をあわせなし、出張に行く回数も仕事が忙しいのか増えてしまっている。ただ仕事を頑張っているのはあなた自身も認めていらっしゃる。仲のいい友人に、この旦那が最近飲みに行ってばかりでとはなしたところ女？と言われてとてもtらかったができれば旦那さんと関係を修復したいと考えているということでよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, starting about two years ago, before COVID, your husband started going out for drinks more often. This made you feel a little anxious and wonder if he was having an affair. Even when he's home, he shuts himself in his study, so you don't see each other much, and he's also going on more business trips, perhaps because work is busy. You acknowledge that he is working hard. When you told a close friend that your husband has been going out drinking all the time, she asked "Another woman?", which was very painful for you. And despite all this, you would like to repair your relationship with your husband if possible. Is that a correct summary?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そんな感じで大丈夫です
dialogue.English: That’s about right.

dialogue.content: そうしましたら、どうやったら旦那さんと前のようにいっぱいしゃべって、デートできるかを考えませんか？
dialogue.English: In that case, shall we think about how you might be able to talk a lot and go on dates with your husband like you used to?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうですねまたどこか一緒にとおもうときはあるので
dialogue.English: Yes, I do sometimes think I'd like to go somewhere together again.

dialogue.content: ええ！そうですよ！例えば、御主人と共通の趣味はありますか？
dialogue.English: Yes! That's the spirit! For example, do you and your husband have any shared hobbies?

dialogue.content: それがないんですよ全く正反対なので
dialogue.English: We don't, actually. We're complete opposites.

dialogue.content: なるほど、そうなんですね。うちも一緒です。
dialogue.English: I see. Same here.

dialogue.content: ただ旅行とかはお互い好きですね
dialogue.English: But we do both like to travel.

dialogue.content: カウンセラーさんも結婚されてるんですか？
dialogue.English: Are you married too, Counselor?

dialogue.content: はい、しております。旅行の計画を立てない？とご主人に誘うのはいかがですか？
dialogue.English: Yes, I am. How about suggesting to your husband, "Shall we plan a trip?"

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: いつも帰りも遅いですしこんな時期に旅行はちょっとともおもうし反対されそうですけど
dialogue.English: He always comes home late, and I feel like traveling at a time like this... he'd probably be against it.

dialogue.content: 最初は、断ってきたらと考えるのは普通に思ってしまいますよね！でも一度チャレンジしてみませんか？
dialogue.English: It’s natural to assume he might refuse at first. But would you be willing to try once?

dialogue.content: そうですよね旅行でなくても近場で観光とか
dialogue.English: You're right... Even if it's not a big trip, we could go sightseeing nearby.

dialogue.content: 誘ってみようと思います少し勇気をだして
dialogue.English: I’ll try inviting him—I’ll muster a bit of courage.

dialogue.content: はい！ドライブでもいいですし旅行いけないなら、一緒にご飯行こうよ、とか会話を続けるきっかけになるかもしれません。
dialogue.English: Yes! Even a drive would be nice. If you can't go on a trip, you could say, "Let's go out for a meal together." It might be a chance to start a conversation.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 近場でもいいので近いうちに誘ってみます
dialogue.English: Even just somewhere nearby would be fine. I'll try inviting him soon.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ええ、ぜひチャレンジしてみてくださいね！応援しています
dialogue.English: Yes, please do give it a try! I'm rooting for you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今日は相談しにきて良かったです
dialogue.English: I'm glad I came to talk to you today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。また、不安なこと、嫌なことうまくいかないことがあったらいつでもいらっしゃってくださいね！結婚はいい時もわるい時も確かにあります。でもチャレンジしてみてできなければ、また一緒に考えましょう！！
dialogue.English: Thank you. If you ever feel anxious, upset, or if things don't go well, please feel free to come back anytime! Marriage certainly has its good times and bad times. But if you try and it doesn't work out, we can think about it together again!

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございましたまた何かあれば相談に来ますね
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. If anything else comes up, I'll come back to talk.

dialogue.content: いつでもお待ちしております！それでは、本日のカウンセリングはここまでとさせていただきますが、よろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'll be here anytime! Well then, I will conclude today's counseling session here. Is that all right?

dialogue.content: 「本日ありがとうございましたとてもいい勉強になりました」
dialogue.English: "Thank you for today. It was a very good learning experience."

dialogue.content: はいまた宜しくお願いしますね
dialogue.English: Yes, I look forward to next time.

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: （お相手していただき、ほんとうにありがとうございました！）
dialogue.English: (Thank you so much for doing this role-play with me!)

dialogue.content: 失礼いたします
dialogue.English: Goodbye.

dialogue.content: 「ありがとうございました」
dialogue.English: "Thank you."

dialogue.content: （こちらこそありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well.)
